key_findings: PPARgamma-positive Vc neurons decrease after re-incision in female but not male rats; intracisternal pioglitazone restores them and strongly suppresses allodynia only in females.
Pioglitazone raises HO-1 and lowers NR1 in female Vc, while minocycline works only in males, indicating a sex-specific PPARgamma pathway.
